title: Erratic g4 xdrip readings
symptom: Readings from the last 3 sensors have been very erratic, jumping from double down to double up constantly throughout the day. The last sensor had to be replaced after three days and the new one is doing the same again.
cause: The thread suggests dehydration as a possible cause, and the user acknowledges that dehydration might be the issue because the child has challenges drinking during the day at school. Poor sensor contact is also mentioned as a possible cause, but the user says they always check contacts.
fix: The thread suggests checking hydration (drinking fluids) and cleaning G4 contacts with an alcohol swab with every change. If those are checked, report the sensor as failed to the supplier without mentioning xDrip or xBridge to avoid voiding warranty. The user thanks for the tip and indicates they will try to get replacements.
evidence_quote: Probably you have already looked into these suggestions, but worth putting them forward. 1) Does this improve if he drinks some fluid? Dehydration can cause this sort of thing (experience it myself all the time). 2) Do you make sure the G4 contacts are cleaned with an alcohol swab with every change? Poor connection to the sensor can often cause this, and I see it occur on myself after 10-15 days.
